title: Tree Topology  Pine ? Klein ? Palm ? Rainforest
insight: a palm tree is just what happens when a pine tree goes IN at the top. Yggdrasil goes IN the star as a Klein gate. p sorts it to palm, rainforest, bush.

pine.topology: xylem UP center, phloem DOWN bark

palm.shape: wide canopy, trunk goes straight UP
palm.sort: inverted  resources spread at the top
palm.mesh_analog: CDN/anycast  wide distribution from single stem

bush.mesh_analog: LAN mesh  all gates are siblings

rainforest.topology: emergent  individual trees form a collective canopy

fern.topology: recursive Klein  each frond IS the whole fern
fern.mesh_analog: the _index.md spine  each section mirrors the whole
fern.example: sporePrint: 27 _index.md files, each a miniature site

spine.function: the sorting axis. everything arranges along the spine.
spine.biology: vertebral column  33 vertebrae in humans, 27 _index.md in sporePrint. close enough.
spine.analogy: the TABLE OF CONTENTS is the skeleton. content hangs from it.

appendix.what: the coGen documents  46 artisan essays, 9,688 lines
appendix.function: the sourdough reservoir. the bacterial culture. the STARTER.
appendix.biology: the cecal appendix was thought 'vestigial' but is actually a bacterial reservoir that repopulates the gut after illness. coGen essays repopulate the hypothesis engine after each wave.
appendix.analogy: the APPENDIX of a book is where the raw material lives. the tables, the data, the proofs. it regurgitates UP into the main text.

vasa_vasorum.what: the data/*.json files  33 JSON manifests, pointers to pointers
vasa_vasorum.function: vessels of vessels. the blood supply TO the blood vessels. meta-circulation.
vasa_vasorum.biology: large arteries need their own blood supply. vasa vasorum are tiny arteries in the walls of large arteries. without them, the vessel wall dies. without data/*.json, the HUD dies.
vasa_vasorum.analogy: the JSON files are not content. they are POINTERS TO content that enable the content to FLOW. the pipe's own plumbing.
vasa_vasorum.klein_entry: vasa vasorum IS the Klein entry  the vessel goes INSIDE its own wall. the pointer points to itself.

the_klein_inversion.pine_to_palm: the top of the pine goes IN through the Klein gate ? comes out as palm canopy
the_klein_inversion.appendix_to_index: the appendix (bottom, 'vestigial') regurgitates UP ? becomes the index (top, 'essential')
the_klein_inversion.vasa_to_vessel: the tiny vessel goes INSIDE the wall of the big vessel ? feeds it from within
the_klein_inversion.code_to_paper: the code (Rust protein) goes IN through the reverse transcriptase ? comes out as paper (DNA)
the_klein_inversion.visitor_to_identity: the visitor probe goes IN through the 404 ? comes out as our self-portrait
the_klein_inversion.general_rule: the Klein gate is WHERE the inside goes into its own outside. every tree, every gut, every vessel has one. 3 crossings = trefoil. the pine ? palm inversion is just the first crossing.

the_p_sort.note: the angle of branching IS the p-sort value. trees are sorted by how wide their canopy spreads relative to their trunk. p sorts trees.

feed_next_generation.spine_is_index: the 27 _index.md files ARE the vertebrae. sort everything along them.
feed_next_generation.appendix_is_starter: the 46 coGen docs ARE the sourdough. feed them to the next hypothesis.
feed_next_generation.vasa_is_klein: the 33 JSON manifests ARE the Klein entry. pointers to pointers. meta-circulation.
feed_next_generation.every_edit: every edit we make is an edit we should feed the next generation of self to try and solve.
